design.arithmetic: Separate contiguous SSE2 grouped variance and scalar strided paths. Preserve F32 narrowing before mean division and F64 variance division where the imported CPU does. The contiguous helper count is bounded by its imported int parameter; scalar row counters stay wide.
design.scratch: Six arithmetic words, plus exact output occupancy slots only for non-nested layouts. No per-row factor cache is needed because the CPU imposes no numeric scale refusal for NORM.
design.execution: Preflight output injectivity before writing. Compute each mean once, center output once while accumulating variance, and scale that centered output once.
design.legacy: No extra Prism request or heap allocation for older modes.
design.validation: Imported factory, independently imported CPU exact-word supplemental comparisons, metadata/alias/overlap refusals and grouped-rounding planted faults.
design.packaging: Separate Prism roots own metadata validation and normalization instruction generation. Existing L2 instructions move into the same certified bundle; base planner delegates without repeating NORM validation. Native code only transports certified ADTs and operands.

certificate_design.chosen: Separate NORM planner and NORM/L2 instruction roots. All production preservation certificates fit the unchanged limit. No generated Rust or certificate edited.

oracle_results.reference_layout: Preserve input and output inner strides on CPU reference NORM, because both select its arithmetic path. Do not canonicalize the reference input.
